verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust server-rendering UI framework, so authoring standards-based web components is a fair axis for it. Its evidence covers only its own typed Rust components (vendored Shadcn-style UI, compile-time-checked props) and hydrated islands that emit vanilla-JS modules. Nothing in the pack shows it authoring or emitting Custom Elements, Shadow DOM, or other Web Components standards, and proprietary component models do not count toward this story.
